reason: The bootstrap stop came from a failed fetch of origin for the board at /home/knatte/Code/loomyard-LYMHUB/_board (trace 95c054eab85b109f, stderr log line 2: "git exited 1"), so the start could not record the machine as task owner. A read-only `git ls-remote --heads origin` against https://github.com/Knatte18/loomyard-weft.git now succeeds and lists refs, so origin answers. A plain re-launch of `lym batten run webster-recovery` settles it, which is the step the envelope itself names.
